candidate_algorithm.description: geometric doubling from max(MEMBRANE_CTXREC_MIN_CANDIDATE=4096, minimum_required_context) up to model_max_context, which is always appended as the final candidate exactly (never dropped, never approximated by the nearest power of two).
candidate_algorithm.overflow_behavior: checked uint64_t arithmetic throughout; doubling stops (and model_max_context is appended directly) before any multiplication could wrap, verified up to model_max_context == UINT64_MAX in test_gen_huge_model_max_bounded_and_no_overflow

unit_test_summary.label: SYNTHETIC
sections_covered: candidate generator (basic doubling, real SmolLM2/Qwen2.5 value, floor==model max, non-power-of-two, below-floor, minimum-exceeds-max, raised floor, small max_out, huge model max / no overflow, NULL safety)

resolve(): ample memory / multiple feasible / largest wins, non-power-of-two end-to-end, NO_FEASIBLE_CONTEXT (no candidates), PLANNER_REJECTED_ALL (unsupported architecture, malformed head shape), minimum_required_context filtering, MINIMUM_EXCEEDS_MODEL_MAX, MODEL_MAX_CONTEXT_UNKNOWN vs INVALID_MODEL_MAX_CONTEXT, CPU-only (explicit precision resolves; adaptive precision's real, disclosed non-resolution documented as its own test), GPU full residency, CPU KV spill, adaptive precision forwarding, explicit q8/q5/gpu-layers/placement hard constraints, ctx-overflow-past-uint32 fails closed, deterministic repeat, no-early-break / non-monotonicity proof, NULL request/out safety

Section 28 property invariants (recommended <= hardware fit <= model max, recommended >= minimum, selected plan feasible, candidate count bound, no candidate exceeds model max, strictly increasing order)

known_limitations.description: Fit estimates cover model weights and the KV cache itself, not ggml's own transient compute-buffer allocation at context-creation time (Phase 32's own disclosed gap, audited again this phase -- no new evidence surfaced a safe, non-arbitrary headroom formula to close it, so it remains open and disclosed rather than papered over with an invented margin).

The existing, unchanged joint planner has never had a real host-RAM capacity check (joint_planner.h's own candidate field comment: 'fits_host... always 1 today'; main.cpp's HOST_MEMORY_PRESSURE warning is explicitly observability-only, never a pass/fail decision). This module does not invent one (Section 12 forbids duplicating memory-fit logic no existing module owns; Section 5 forbids an unevidenced margin) -- instead it sets host_memory_unvalidated=true whenever the selected plan leaves any weight/KV bytes host-resident, so this is never silently claimed as safe.

Real, source-verified finding this phase: joint_planner.c's resolve_adaptive_precision() always calls membrane_adaptive_kv_resolve() with is_gpu_backend hardcoded to 1, and returns GPU_MEMORY_INSUFFICIENT (no CPU-only fallback) rather than a legal CPU-only plan when neither Q8 nor Q5 reaches even one GPU layer -- unlike resolve_single_precision() (explicit --kv native/q8/q5), which always includes a gpu_layers=0 fallback candidate. A genuinely GPU-less host must reach this module with an explicit precision request, matching main.cpp's own real gpu_layers==0 short-circuit (which never invokes the joint planner with an implicit adaptive request at all).
